name: Contact Wound
source:
FOR: Head of Cascadia Section
Memorandum regarding the incident on August 28th, 1999, leading to the loss of three (3) officers of the Seattle branch.

Diana Nakazawa has been out in the cold for a while. 

She would dearly like to get back to her work of the last decade.

But the work is coming to her. And she's not going to like what it brings.

A game by Summer Triangle about mind control, identity, and the things that grow in the dark.

[from [url=https://summertriangle.itch.io/contact-wound]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
致：卡斯卡迪亚分部主管
关于1999年8月28日导致西雅图支部三名（3名）干员折损事件的备忘录。

黛安娜·中泽已经被冷落闲置了好一阵子。

她无比渴望重返自己过去十年间一直投身其中的老本行。

然而如今，工作主动找上了门来——而随之而来的东西，绝不会让她感到愉快。

由Summer Triangle开发的作品，探讨精神控制、身份认同，以及那些在黑暗中悄然滋长的诡异之物。

[摘自[url=https://summertriangle.itch.io/contact-wound]itch.io[/url]]
